title: Compostable Bamboo Toothbrush - Biodegradable & Zero Waste

data.title: Compostable Bamboo Toothbrush - Biodegradable & Zero Waste
data.body_text:
300 toothbrushes. That's how many each of us uses in a lifetime. Almost all of them plastic. Almost all of them in a landfill or ocean right now.

This one isn't.

Our FDA-approved compostable bamboo toothbrush is built for the whole family - a biodegradable bamboo handle, BPA-free nylon bristles infused with black bamboo charcoal, and a water-repellant anti-fungal coating that keeps it fresh between uses.

Comes in 4 colours so everyone gets their own - no bathroom confusion, no plastic guilt.

Zero waste oral care. Made in India.

Over 4.7 billion plastic toothbrushes are produced every year. Every bamboo toothbrush you choose is one less plastic one in the ocean.

•
Apply toothpaste like you normally would and brush away. Once done, wipe down the handle of the bamboo toothbrush and let it dry. Wash them with water and vinegar once every 2 months for thorough cleaning

• Once done, there are many ways to ensure the jar doesn’t go waste. Once your toothbrush has reached the end of its life, pluck the bristles and compost the bamboo handle! As of now, a solution for bristles doesn't exist in the Indian market while still ensuring zero waste and ensuring the toothbrush remains accessible to the masses! We are doing immense research on this to bring you a fully compostable bamboo toothbrush. With that said, by investing in our toothbrush, you are eliminating majority of the plastic waste that ends up in our landfills, from the handle, to the grips, to the colours and the various layers. If this isn't time for innovation, when is?!

Country of Origin: India
Packed by: Brand C Zero Waste Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
49, II Block, Koramangala, Bangalore, 560034, India

--------------

MRP: Rs.100/- incl. of all taxes (per unit)
